{{2025–26 Big 12 men's basketball standings}}

The '''2025–26 Baylor Bears men's basketball team''' represented [[Baylor University]] during the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]], the Bears' 120th season. The Bears, members of the [[Big 12 Conference]], played their home games at [[Foster Pavilion]]. They were led by 23rd-year head coach [[Scott Drew]].

==Previous season==
The [[2024–25 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Bears]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25 season]] 20–15, 10–10 in [[2024–25 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in a tie for seventh place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2025 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2024–25 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the number nine seed in the East Region,<ref>{{cite web |title=BU is making its school-record sixth-straight NCAA Tournament appearance |url=https://baylorbears.com/news/2025/3/16/mens-basketball-mbb-earns-ncaa-tournament-no-9-seed-in-the-xxx-region}}</ref> where they defeated [[2024–25 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]] in the first round before losing in the second round to [[2024–25 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]].<ref>{{cite web |title=MBB Advances Past Mississppi State in NCAA First Round, 75-72 |url=https://baylorbears.com/news/2025/3/21/mens-basketball-mbb-advances-past-mississppi-state-in-ncaa-first-round-75-72}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=No. 9 MBB Falls to No. 1 Duke in the Round of 32 |url=https://baylorbears.com/news/2025/3/23/mens-basketball-no-9-mbb-falls-to-no-1-duke-in-the-round-of-32}}</ref>
